verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client. Routing all of a device's internet traffic through an exit node is a VPN/network-connectivity capability outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any traffic-routing or exit-node feature: the WebDAV server and External URL preview are file-transfer and preview features, not network routing.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can route all my internet traffic through a specific device on my network using an exit node
